notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective at the end of the transition period, as defined in section 9681 of this title, see section 9684 of this title.

notes.heading: Appropriation of Moneys in Advance as Requisite to Purchases, Investments, or Other Acquisitions of Equity by Fund Created Under Pilot Equity Finance Program
notes.text: Pub. L. 100–461, title V, § 555, Oct. 1, 1988, 102 Stat. 2268–36, provided in part: “That purchases, investments or other acquisitions of equity by the fund created by section 104 of H.R. 5263 as hereby enacted [former 22 U.S.C. 2194(g)(5)] are limited to such amounts as may be provided in advance in appropriations Acts” , and further provided “That purchases, investments or other acquisitions of equity by the fund created by section 104 of S. 2757 as hereby enacted [former 22 U.S.C. 2194(g)(5)] are limited to such amounts as may be provided in advance in appropriations Acts”.

notes.heading: Overseas Private Investment Corporation; Reaffirmation of Support
notes.text: Pub. L. 100–418, title II, § 2203(a), Aug. 23, 1988, 102 Stat. 1328, provided that Congress reaffirmed its support for the former Overseas Private Investment Corporation as a United States Government agency serving important development assistance goals.
